title: Main Menu Credits Unborked
description: Unborked version of isXander's Main Menu Credits for 1.21.6-11. Makes e.g. clickable links work again.
body:
# Main Menu Credits _Unborked_
[This is a fork of the original by isXander.](https://modrinth.com/mod/main-menu-credits)

Adds a way of adding information to the user's title screen.

![preview](https://i.imgur.com/vvIfvYG.png)

User can interact with the text like any chat message with click events
and is underlined on hover if a click event is present.

## What's different from the standard version?
- This version is exclusively for 1.21.6-1.21.11.
- It fixes an issue with clickable links not working anymore.
- It also allows you to create hover text.

## Wiki
For usage information, [consult the wiki](https://github.com/isXander/main-menu-credits/wiki/Usage)
